content: Amma, waɗiɗe ɗee waɗi soɓɓi fayde waɗi tan nder lewru ɗiɗi, so ɓe hefti 800,000 nden gulɗi e Red Army makko Soviet waɗi habaru nden e nder ndiyam, ɓe waɗi jooɗi nder frontoji Belarus e Ukraine kadi ɓe yeeytii naange ngol ndiyam e fulɓe anndormi Poland ngam yaru Riga, jamɗugol Soviet-Poland to wonaa yamirde, e kadi kammujiiji mabbe ɓen e dow laawolji adunaaji tan e dow laawolji haɗɗe.
